name: Sync main from upstream daily
ask:
Write one recurring supervised script that keeps this clone's `main` in sync with the original repository (`upstream` = https://github.com/HazAT/ultimate.git) once a day. Project root: /home/bsylla/ultimate.

Path `.ultimate/automations/sync-upstream/run`: an executable Node 26 ESM script using only node builtins and `git`/`pnpm`; small and readable. Support `--once` to run a single pass immediately and exit (for testing and `automation run`), otherwise loop forever, exiting cleanly on SIGTERM.

Without `--once`: sleep in short chunks until the next 06:00 UTC, run one pass, repeat.

One pass, every git call with `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` and `-C /home/bsylla/ultimate`:
1. `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` must be `main`; otherwise print a progress line and skip the pass.
2. If `.git/ultimate-update.lock` exists (the update extension's clone-wide lock), print progress and retry every 15 minutes, at most 6 times, then skip the day.
3. If `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no` is non-empty, print progress and retry every 30 minutes for up to 8 hours; then `FIRE working tree still dirty after 8h: <first 3 paths>`.
4. `git fetch --quiet upstream main`; on failure `FIRE fetch from upstream failed: <stderr>`.
5. If `git merge-base --is-ancestor upstream/main HEAD` succeeds, print `up to date <short sha>` and end the pass.
6. Record the pre-merge HEAD, then `git merge --no-edit upstream/main`. On conflict: run `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U`, then `git merge --abort`, then `FIRE upstream merge conflicts in: <paths> — nothing merged, main is at <short sha>`, and end the pass.
7. If `pnpm-lock.yaml` is in `git diff --name-only <pre>..HEAD`, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`; if that fails, `FIRE merged <short sha> but pnpm install failed: <last 3 lines>` and do not push.
8. `git push origin main`; on failure `FIRE merged <short sha> locally but the push to origin failed: <stderr>`.
9. Wake the user only when the merged range touched `server/`, `shared/` or `bin/`, or packages were installed: `FIRE synced to <short sha> — needs a host restart`, naming the commit count and touched areas. Otherwise print `synced to <short sha>: <n> commits, reload only` and end the pass with no FIRE.

Hard rules: never rebase, reset, force-push, stash or resolve a conflict; the only change to the working tree is the merge itself; write nothing else inside the repo; no new dependencies.

Verify with one real pass (`node .ultimate/automations/sync-upstream/run --once`), show its output, then enable the automation with `automation resume`. Report: what the test pass did (commits found, merged, pushed, restart needed), the exact path of the script, and anything the user must know.
